title: bro this AI game is NOT playing fair 💀🔥
author: darlzeee
selftext:
ok bro you HAVE to try this because this is not what i expected an AI game to be 😭

basically you pick a character and she's already mad at you for some reason you don't even know yet.

then you get a LIMITED number of messages to talk your way out of it.

no continues. no mercy.

say something weak? she's not even mad anymore, she's just disappointed and somehow that's WORSE 💀

say something dumb? bro she POSTS A STORY about it. like an actual story calling you out in the app.

i got publicly shamed by a fictional character 😭

and if you REALLY mess it up, she stops typing and sends you a voice note instead. 💀??? Wtf 

FULL MONOLOGUE. ZERO CHILL.

i literally had to put my phone down for a second 💀

and the anger meter???

say the right thing → it drops.

say ONE wrong thing → 📈📈📈

it's basically a conversation where every reply actually matters.

and every character is different too, so whatever worked on one can completely destroy you with another.

there's even a leaderboard for people who got absolutely obliterated 💀

try it and see how long you survive 😭

https://rosybae.com
